capabilities: Sort completed tasks to the bottom of a list
Sort incomplete tasks by due or scheduled date
Clear completed tasks at a list level or across a document
Recognise cancelled statuses from the Tasks plugin
Adjust sorting and clearing rules via settings
disambiguation: Not a task manager; it only sorts and clears items in existing Markdown task lists and does not create or track tasks.
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. The README documents unhandled cases (ordered lists, multiple cursors) and a manual upgrade path from the former Todo Sorting plugin ID.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in commands to sort task lists by completion or date, or to remove completed tasks from a list or note.

relations.evidence: When the Tasks plugin is installed, symbols with type CANCELLED in its core or custom status settings also count as cancelled.
Version 2.0.0 changed the plugin ID from todo-sort-completed to organise-tasks.

summary: Command-based task organiser that sorts completed tasks to the bottom, orders tasks by due or scheduled date, and clears completed items.
